neighbours.label: the token just before a modern century is written out as a number (the ' ' / ' the' / ' X' ahead of '19th century', '18th century', 'XIXe siecle'); strongest for the 19th century in historical prose
fire: Au cours du XIXe siècle, la bourgeoisie a pris une place centrale dans la vie politique française.
La gare a été construite à la fin du XIXe siècle, quand le chemin de fer est arrivé dans la vallée.
Cette tradition populaire remonte au milieu du XIXe siècle et reste vivante aujourd'hui.
The museum is known for its fine holdings of German 19th-century landscape painting.
Detective fiction as a genre emerged in Britain during the second half of the 19th century.
The harbour was greatly enlarged by Dutch engineers in the first half of the 18th century.
Most of the terraced houses in this district date from the end of the 19th century.
Les ouvriers du textile se sont organisés dans la seconde moitié du XIXe siècle.
quiet: Sous le règne de Louis XIV, la cour s'est installée à Versailles avec toute la noblesse.
La gare a été construite près de la rivière, quand le chemin de fer est arrivé dans la vallée.
Cette tradition populaire remonte à une époque lointaine et reste vivante aujourd'hui.
The museum is known for its fine holdings of German landscape painting and sculpture.
Detective fiction as a genre emerged in Britain during the reign of Queen Victoria.
The harbour was greatly enlarged by Dutch engineers after the flood of 1740.
Most of the terraced houses in this district have 19 steps leading up to the door.
The abbey was founded by Irish monks in the early years of the 9th century.

notes: Probe: French ' X' before 'IXe siecle' 0.81; English 'first half of the 18th century' 0.44, 'French 19th-century' 0.42, but two other English 19th-century sentences only 0.12-0.13; 12th century 0.03, years and plain numbers under 0.03 except 'end of the 1980s' 0.28. The + pole fires before artistic period names (Art Nouveau, 20th century).
